task_text: IKEA MuJoCo IKEA 365+ serving stand (IKEA 365+ serving stand (AA-2568481-2)) with two 7-DoF Franka Panda arms, each with the MuJoCo Menagerie Panda hand (two-finger, tendon-coupled). Rebuild the IKEA 365+ serving stand: take the screw out of member A and park it, lay member B across member A, bring the screw back and screw it in through both members until it seats, turn the stand over, and place the bowl on it. Success requirements: The seven operations are accepted in this order: remove the screw, park the screw, cross the members, return the screw, reinstall the screw, turn the stand, place the bowl. At the end the screw is retained in member A and aligned with its seated pose relative to both members, and member B is retained and aligned with member A (gates: axial 0.1 mm, lateral 0.6 mm, axis 1.5 degrees; member B may be rotated 180 degrees). Released and settled: no robot contact with any part, every part slower than 0.025 m/s, the bench carries the parts; the bowl touches the members and member A is turned over (its z axis pointing down). A support probe on a copy of the final state: the bench must carry the whole weight, and the weight plus a 2 N downward test load on member A (the grader applies it; it never acts during your episode), with the arms holding their last commands. The benchmark's terminal rules, the same in every IKEA MuJoCo task, come on top of these requirements. When your rows end: (1) the requirements above hold; (2) the parts are released: no robot link touches any part; (3) every part is at rest: at most 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s; (4) the simulation never broke down: no non-finite state, no MuJoCo BADQACC / BADQPOS / BADQVEL warning, no contact of a part deeper than 10 mm, at any time. The grader then holds your last row for 1.0 s more and requires (1)-(4) again at its end. Mechanism: The M4 x 0.5 thread is exact convex pieces: the screw advances only by being turned. Two retention welds (screw to member A, member B to member A) switch on with the current relative pose once the reinstalled screw is seated.
